subject.name: hexagonal gold coin
subject.context: the gold currency icon for Out of Ruin, a stylised hand-painted fantasy idle dungeon RPG; it appears in the header beside the gold total and as the flipbook the gold particles spin through

silhouette.description: a broad hexagon lying on its side, flat along the top and the bottom and coming to a point at the left and at the right
landmarks: flat horizontal top edge, about half the coin's width
flat horizontal bottom edge of the same length
a point at the left and a point at the right, each slightly blunted and rounded
four slanted sides running between the flats and the points
a broad raised rim band following the whole border, about a sixth of the coin's width deep
a soft bevelled lip stepping down from the rim band into a smaller hexagon of the same shape
small square studs pressed into the rim band at even spacing
silhouette.aspect_feel: squat and wide; about one tenth wider than it is tall

pose_orientation.angle: strictly front-on, flat to the camera, orthographic
pose_orientation.rotation: upright and bilaterally symmetric about a vertical centre line; the flats stay horizontal
pose_orientation.spin_axis: the coin's own vertical centre line; the flipbook turns it about this axis and nothing else moves

materials.color_description: bright saturated gold, catching to a pale warm yellow (#FCF448) along the upper-left and deepening to burnt amber (#D57A01) at the lower right
materials.finish: smooth painted metal with one soft glossy sheen, not specular
materials.coverage: the outer sixth of the coin, all the way round

materials.color_description: a deeper gold than the rim, lit yellow (#FDDA20) at the upper left falling through amber (#EDA104) to a dark burnt amber (#B55601) at the lower right
materials.finish: smooth painted metal, matte beside the rim
materials.coverage: the middle two thirds of the coin

materials.zone: bevelled lip between rim and face
materials.color_description: lit gold along the top of the step, dropping to a deep burnt amber (#A23F00) along the bottom of it
materials.finish: a soft rounded chamfer, no hard crease
materials.coverage: a narrow band between the rim and the inset face

materials.zone: the coin's thickness, its milled edge
materials.color_description: a step darker than the face, warm amber brown, brightest where it meets the lit face and sinking into deep amber round the coin's curve
materials.finish: smooth painted metal, no ridges or knurling
materials.coverage: about a sixth of the coin's width; only visible once the coin turns

wear_and_detail.type: small square blocky brush dabs as texture accents
wear_and_detail.location: spaced along the raised rim band

wear_and_detail.type: a small white four-point star glint
wear_and_detail.location: on the rim band at the upper left

outline.thickness: thin, about 1 part in 90 of the coin's width
outline.softness: hard and crisp, hugging the silhouette
outline.note: a darker shade of the coin's own gold, never black

lighting.shadow_softness: soft continuous gradient, no bands and no cel steps
lighting.highlight_type: one broad soft glossy sheen along the upper-left rim plus a single small white four-point star glint; subdued, not bright specular
lighting.ambient: warm; the shadow side falls into burnt amber rather than grey

style.shading: smooth painted gradients rolling from a lit upper-left to a darker lower-right, continuous with no tone bands
style.edges: crisp straight hexagon sides with generously rounded outer corners; the rim band's inner step is a soft chamfer
style.surface_detail: low: a handful of square blocky dabs, no fine lines, no scratches, no noise
style.color_approach: bright and fully saturated gold, warm throughout, smooth blends between the values
style.form_language: chunky, simplified and a little oversized; a bold silhouette that still reads at 24 pixels
style.material_rendering: gold told by a warm yellow body, an orange shadow and one bright glint
style.overall_feel: polished stylised mobile fantasy RPG UI, in the icon register of ARTSTYLE.md; never photoreal, never 3D-rendered, never cel-shaded, never outlined in black

composition.framing: centred, bilaterally symmetric about the frame's vertical centre line, the flats parallel to the frame's top and bottom
composition.scale: the coin spans about 80% of the frame's width at its widest, leaving room for the edge that swings out as it turns
composition.padding: about a tenth of the frame on every side

spin_flipbook.covers: half a turn, 180 degrees, which is a whole visual cycle because both faces are the same
spin_flipbook.playback: loop forward at 30 fps, the atlas animation coin_spin

poses.description: square to the camera; no edge showing
turned a little, the near face swung right, a narrow strip of the coin's thickness along its left
turned well over, the face squeezed to half its width, a broad strip of thickness along its left
edge on: an upright bar of the coin's thickness, as tall as the coin and about a sixth as wide
past edge on, the far face come round, squeezed to half its width, a broad strip of thickness along its right
nearly square again, the face swung left, a narrow strip of thickness along its right
